bull.t: Recurring subscription scale and high gross margins
bull.b: Zscaler's subscription-based cloud security model has delivered multi-year top-line scaling with ~77% gross margins. Durable recurring revenue and strong unit economics support predictable cash flow, high lifetime value, and sustained reinvestment capacity for product and go-to-market expansion.

bull.t: Industry-leading cash generation and improving leverage
bull.b: Rapid growth in operating and free cash flow provides durable financial flexibility for capex, M&A and debt service. Improved leverage (debt-to-equity down toward ~0.79x TTM) reduces refinancing risk and strengthens the company's ability to fund strategic investments without dilutive financing.

bull.t: Platform momentum, AI/data security adoption and marketplace traction
bull.b: Growing AI/security modules, accelerating data-security ARR and an expanding cloud marketplace indicate deepening product stickiness and cross-sell potential. Platform breadth and ecosystem partnerships create structural competitive advantages and multiple monetization levers over the medium term.

bear.b: Management's early FY27 outlook signals a structural slowdown from mid-20s to mid-teens growth. Slower ARR expansion reduces operating leverage potential, may compress future margin expansion and slows the pace at which scale converts into higher free cash flow growth.

bear.t: Higher near-term CapEx pressuring free cash flow margins
bear.b: Elevated capex driven by data center/branch equipment and AI infrastructure pull‑forwards materially reduces reported free cash flow margins in the medium term. Sustained higher capital intensity would limit cash available for buybacks, debt paydown or opportunistic investments.

bear.t: Continued GAAP unprofitability and negative returns on equity
bear.b: Although margins and cash flow have improved, persistent GAAP losses and negative ROE indicate shareholder capital is not yet generating accounting profits. This constraint can limit strategic optionality and keep the company reliant on sustained operating improvements to deliver durable GAAP profitability.
